description: 原住民族部落特色道路改善計畫工程經費明細表 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 原住民族委員會. 原住民族委員會補助原鄉地區改善特色道路，通暢部落產業交通命脈，以提升原鄉道路品質，促進經濟產業發展等計畫之經費明細包含中央補助款及地方配合款及總經費等。 計畫補助單位公告。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 原住民族委員會. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, xml, csv. The portal shows 2026-04-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
